active_v4.fee_state_effect: Confirmed fee value has no replacement UTXO and therefore leaves the spendable UTXO set: implicit burn/unassigned destruction.

research_300.coinbase_value_rule: sum(coinbase outputs) = subsidy + included transaction fees
research_300.issuance_counter_semantics: issuedSubsidyAtoms counts subsidy only; recycled fees do not consume the issuance cap

invariant_findings: Fees are transfers/destruction choices, not new issuance. A supply cap must count newly minted subsidy, not subsidy+recycled fees.
For each transaction: inputs = outputs + fee, fee >= 0.
For each block: fee_total must be recomputed from exactly the included transactions and committed fail-closed.
Any credited fee outputs must sum exactly to the credited share of fee_total; no hidden fee creation is admissible.
Reorg/replay must deterministically reverse and recompute fee destinations.
A non-miner fee recipient is a policy allocation and cannot be silently introduced under the no-treasury/fair-launch constraint.
